scope: Command attempt only; JUnit and final acceptance remain separate.

command:
import hashlib
import importlib.metadata
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import agentsync

install, checkout, manifest = map(Path, sys.argv[1:4])
version = sys.argv[4]
assert sys.version_info[:3] == (3, 12, 16)
assert Path(sys.prefix).resolve() == install.resolve()
checkout = checkout.resolve(strict=True)
source = checkout / "src"
origin = Path(agentsync.__file__).resolve()
assert origin == source / "agentsync" / "__init__.py"
assert agentsync.__version__ == version
dist = importlib.metadata.distribution("agentsync-local")
assert dist.version == version
assert Path(dist.locate_file("")).resolve().is_relative_to(install.resolve())
direct = json.loads(dist.read_text("direct_url.json"))
assert direct["url"] == checkout.as_uri()
assert direct["dir_info"]["editable"] is True and "archive_info" not in direct
expected = json.loads(manifest.read_bytes())
assert len(expected) == 97
actual = {
    file.relative_to(source).as_posix(): hashlib.sha256(file.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    for file in (source / "agentsync").rglob("*")
    if file.is_file() and "__pycache__" not in file.parts
}
assert actual == expected
print(json.dumps({"python": sys.version, "version": version, "origin": str(origin),
                  "runtime_members": len(actual), "direct_url": direct}))
